SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, b.price, b.stock, b.description, b.create_time AS createTime, b.update_time AS updateTime FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, isbn, category_id, price, stock, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE book SET stock = stock - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
UPDATE book SET stock = stock + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
